_doc2: All tunable parameters live here. 'offline' section is baked at startup; 'runtime' is used every tick. Restart server after changes.

selection._doc: Last-resort fallback (Step 3) when garage is essentially full.

offline._doc: Geometry parameters — read once at startup.
offline._doc_zone: ZONE RADIUS — competition threshold for Phase 1 (initial) and Step 1 (reassignment).
offline._doc_zone_multi: MULTI: zone_radius = (min_inter_dist/2) × zone_radius_frac_multi. RAISE to stay on floor longer.
offline._doc_zone_single: SINGLE: zone_radius = walk_dists[pct]. RAISE for later competition.
offline._doc_local: SPIRAL BASE — starting ring for multi-instance spiral.
offline._doc_spiral: SPIRAL EXPANSION — ring grows by this factor each step. LOWER = more symmetric instance fill.
offline._doc_walk_tol: INSTANCE-SWITCHING HYSTERESIS (Phase 1 spiral) — inst-k only wins when walk saves k×tolerance vs inst-1. Lower = more symmetric.
offline._doc_competition: FLOOR COMPETITION SCORING — score = drive_time + walk_weight × walk + floor_depth × floor_penalty.
offline._doc_comp_radius: COMPETITION ZONE CAP — subsequent floors only enter competition if a spot exists within zone_radius × comp_radius_growth_factor^(depth-1). depth=1 for next floor, depth=2 for two above, etc. This prevents distant spots on higher floors from winning prematurely. Single: closest-walk within cap. Multi: spiral within cap, one winner (uses comp_walk_tolerance_frac). Set comp_radius_growth_factor=9999 to disable the cap.
offline._doc_comp_walk_tol: COMPETITION SPIRAL WALK TOLERANCE — lower than walk_tolerance_frac, for more symmetric instance switching when picking the single competition representative from a multi-instance floor.

runtime._doc: Read at runtime during every assignment.
runtime._doc_walk_weight: Walk penalty in reassignment Step 2 scoring.
runtime._doc_floor_change_expansion: Zone radius multiplier per completed floor change in reassignment Step 1: zone = zone_radius × floor_change_expansion^n.
